notes.title: UPDATE 1.20
notes.content: [p][b]🚨 Major Update is Here! 🚨[/b][/p][p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We’re beyond excited to finally share one of the biggest updates we’ve ever made to the game! This update brings tons of new content, improvements, and fixes — all based on your feedback and our continued passion for making the game better every day.[/p]

notes.title: Content Expansion Update
notes.content:
We are introducing something new. From now on we will be introducing extra chapters and assets into the game independent of the DLCs that will be included in the future.
The first addition will be an introductory chapter that will help expand the world of "The Garden of Earthly Delights."

Soon, we will introduce DLCs that will present a more complex development of the adventure. Each DLC will have a new story to enrich our universe. I hope you like it.

Thanks!!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.10
notes.content:
[b]Major Update available[/b]
Included in this update
:
1) A Save System Gallery. The player can now generate a thumbnail corresponding to a point in the game's narrative.
2) Option to adjust screen (fullscreen, windows etc)
3) You can choose the language at the beginning of the game after loading (English, Portuguese, Spanish).
4) Some bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: New save system (including Gallery Mode) coming soon!
notes.content:
I'm working on a menu save system to replace the current system [b](English version only)[/b].
New save system (including Gallery Mode) coming soon!

1. Manage to create up to 9 save/load slots or more
2. Saves are made with a thumbnail image and date (Gallery Mode)
3. The asset will support autosave for which a separate slot is allocated
4. Easy to show save menu by pressing Esc.
or UI button
5. Possibility to delete saved data to facilitate testing
6. Possibility to customize the view of the save/load menu

Soon this new update will be available for all players.
